nodes.label: Базовые свечные паттерны (Basic Candlestick Patterns Chart)
nodes.description: Educational chart showing four basic candlestick patterns on a forex price axis (~1.078-1.084 range): Hammer (bullish reversal), Bullish Engulfing, Doji (uncertainty), and Shooting Star. Labels in Russian.

nodes.label: Молот (Hammer) — Bullish Reversal Pattern
nodes.description: Candlestick pattern with long lower wick and small body, signals bullish reversal. Labeled 'Молот (разворот вверх)' in the chart.

nodes.label: Поглощение бычье (Bullish Engulfing Pattern)
nodes.description: Two-candle pattern where a large bullish (green) candle fully engulfs the previous bearish (red) candle. Labeled 'Поглощение (бычье)' in the chart.

nodes.label: Доджи (Doji) — Uncertainty Pattern
nodes.description: Candlestick with nearly equal open and close, forming a cross shape, signals market indecision. Labeled 'Доджи (неопределённость)' in the chart.

nodes.label: Падающая звезда (Shooting Star) — Bearish Reversal Pattern
nodes.description: Candlestick with long upper wick and small body near the low, signals bearish reversal. Labeled 'Падающая звезда' in the chart.
